conversion.overall: Ours, not the game's: Madden NFL 2000 kept its players' attributes but no overall. Each player's attributes are weighted as Madden NFL 2001's overall weights them (least squares on its EA overall, by group: QB THP THA AWR SPD AGI ACC; RB SPD ACC AGI AWR STR CAR; WR SPD ACC AGI AWR CTH; TE SPD ACC AGI AWR STR CTH; OT AWR STR AGI PBK RBK; OG AWR STR AGI PBK RBK; C AWR STR AGI PBK RBK; DL STR SPD ACC AGI AWR TAK; LB SPD ACC AGI AWR STR TAK; CB SPD ACC AGI AWR TAK CTH; S SPD ACC AGI AWR TAK CTH; K AWR KPW KAC), ranked among the season's players at his game position (mid-rank percentile, ties sharing one) and read off Madden NFL 2002's overalls at that position (the 2001 season: maddenratings.net's 31 team spreadsheets, punters left out), as many of each Madden team's best as the season carries per club, by linear interpolation; rounded and held to 1–99. A generic defensive back (DB) plays safety where nflverse lists him at safety that season, else corner.
